one_liner: B2B support platform with a broad read/write REST API (admin-created bearer tokens) and an official hosted MCP server, but every plan is sales-led (book a demo, annual contract).
notes: auth: the REST API uses admin-created API tokens sent as Bearer; no OAuth for the public REST API. The MCP server additionally supports OAuth sign-in, but that is MCP-only, so auth_methods = api_key. access: the pricing page lists API and MCP on every plan (Professional $89/seat, Advanced $139/seat, Enterprise custom), but all CTAs are 'Book a demo' / 'Talk to sales' on annual contracts, and trials are set up by a sales rep ('free trials for prospects'). No self-serve signup or free plan found -> contact_sales, verdict blocked. If Pylon allowed a self-serve trial this would flip to self_serve_trial/ready; the vendor FAQ says the trial goes through a sales rep. mcp: official hosted server at mcp.usepylon.com (OAuth or API token), documented on docs.usepylon.com. api_style: REST (JSON over HTTP, about 22 resource groups, official TS/Python/Go SDKs and an experimental CLI).
